subject: Staggered signature playbook and MAP for HelixBio pilot
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily@helixbiotech.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixbiotech.com, Ben Shaw <ben@helixbiotech.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP and procurement sequencing for HelixBio pilot

Hi Olga —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to send our rough timeline and the security questionnaire so your team can map dependencies. We have a hard budget window and need the pilot kicked off by June 21 to hit internal funding milestones.

Attached: helix_security_q.pdf, helix_procurement_timeline.xlsx

High level asks from our side:
- Can we get a proposal that splits legal steps so we can start the pilot without waiting on every doc?
- Any way to accelerate the DPA review? That’s our main blocker for data access.
- Who should our procurement team loop into authorship for the order form / PO steps?

Emily Carter
Head of Product Operations
HelixBio
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily@helixbiotech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and procurement sequencing for HelixBio pilot

Emily — thanks for the materials. Sounds doable if we split the workstreams and accept a staggered signature approach. Proposal from our side (high level):

1) Execute MSA (core commercial terms) first via DocuSign within 5 business days. This secures pricing and liability terms so legal procurement can issue a PO against the order form once live.
2) Run the DPA in parallel but treat it as a gating artifact for production data. Pilot can start with pseudonymized/synthetic payloads if the DPA review runs over the required window.
3) Order form: finalize immediately after MSA signature; it will include pilot scope, billing cadence, and acceptance criteria.
4) MAP (attached) with week-by-week milestones: legal review windows, procurement PO, pilot deliverables, and go/no-go decision date.

I attached a suggested MAP and a cleaned-up timeline that identifies the critical path (DPA appendix and data residency). If Helix can accept a limited-data appendix for the pilot, we can begin earlier.

Next steps: can Karthik and Laura review the DPA items and turn around redlines by EOD tomorrow? Also, who on procurement should I coordinate with for PO / order form language?

Attachments: proposed_map_v2.xlsx

—
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Carter <emily@helixbiotech.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and procurement sequencing for HelixBio pilot

Looping in our legal position so Emily has visibility. High-level comments after a quick pass on the Helix DPA and security questionnaire:

- Data residency / cross-border transfer language needs clarification (Helix marked some EU-region boxes but their procurement contact listed a US PO). We need confirmation on final hosting region to avoid a longer review.
- Recommend the following staged approach to avoid blocking the commercial start:
  * Stage A (MSA signature): sign commercial MSA with a data appendix placeholder that limits pilot to pseudonymized data and purpose-built access controls. Use DocuSign link to lock commercial terms quickly.
  * Stage B (DPA completion): finalize DPA with Helix’s security lead; incorporate required SCCs / transfer mechanisms if production PD is needed. Expect ~10–15 business days if back-and-forth is modest.
  * Stage C (Order Form and PO): once MSA is signed, exchange order form and allow Helix procurement to raise a PO for pilot spend; collect PO to enable provisioning.

If Helix confirms the pilot will accept pseudonymized data, we can start the technical onboarding within 72 hours of MSA signature. If not, we will need the DPA and the regional hosting confirmation before provisioning.

I’ll prepare redlines for the MSA and a targeted DPA checklist today and push as tracked changes (redlines_msa_v1.docx). Olga — if you can share the DocuSign envelope or hubspot record we’ll attach the redlines there.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Emily Carter <emily@helixbiotech.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixbiotech.com
Date: 2026-05-21T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP and procurement sequencing for HelixBio pilot

Thanks, Karthik & Olga — that staged flow works for us. Procurement (procurement@helixbiotech.com) has been CC'd; Ben will be the PO owner.

We can confirm pilot will accept pseudonymized data for initial onboarding. We also confirmed the hosting region should be us-west for this pilot.

Action items from Helix side:
- Procurement will prepare an initial PO after MSA signature (Ben Shaw).
- Security will work with Karthik on the DPA appendix; I’ll introduce the security lead if helpful.

Please proceed with DocuSign for the MSA and share the envelope link. We’ll aim to turn the PO within 3 business days after MSA signature.
